fonrex_eod.name: Fonrex EOD History
fonrex_eod.description: End-of-day OHLCV price history with auto-ingestion on first request

fonrex_history.name: Fonrex OHLCV History
fonrex_history.description: OHLCV price history with date range filtering

fonrex_quote.name: Fonrex Quote
fonrex_quote.description: Latest real-time price snapshot from WebSocket stream with Redis cache

fonrex_quotes_batch.name: Fonrex Batch Quotes
fonrex_quotes_batch.description: Batch price snapshots for multiple tickers in a single request

fonrex_technical.name: Fonrex Technical Indicator
fonrex_technical.description: Single technical indicator (RSI, SMA, EMA, MACD, Bollinger Bands, etc.)

params.label: Indicator
params.description: Indicator name (rsi, sma, ema, macd, bbands, atr, obv, etc.)

params.label: Period
params.description: Indicator period (e.g. 14 for RSI, 20 for SMA)

fonrex_technical_multi.name: Fonrex Multi-Indicator
fonrex_technical_multi.description: Multiple technical indicators computed from a single database read

params.label: Indicators
params.description: Comma-separated indicator list (e.g. sma_20, ema_50, rsi_14, macd)

fonrex_technical_chart.name: Fonrex Technical Chart
fonrex_technical_chart.description: OHLCV candlestick data with overlaid technical indicators, chart-ready

params.label: Indicators
params.description: Comma-separated indicator list (e.g. sma_20, bbands_20, macd)

fonrex_screener.name: Fonrex Technical Screener
fonrex_screener.description: Screen stocks by technical indicator thresholds (e.g. RSI < 30 for oversold)

params.label: Indicator
params.description: Technical indicator to screen (rsi, sma, ema, macd, etc.)

params.label: Operator
params.description: Comparison operator (lt, gt, lte, gte, eq)

fonrex_news.name: Fonrex News
fonrex_news.description: Aggregated financial news from 7 providers with URL deduplication

params.label: Limit
params.description: Maximum number of articles to return

fonrex_news_feed.name: Fonrex News Feed
fonrex_news_feed.description: Global financial news feed across all tracked tickers

params.label: Limit
params.description: Maximum number of articles to return

fonrex_dcf.name: Fonrex DCF Valuation
fonrex_dcf.description: Discounted Cash Flow intrinsic value using FCF, EPS and DDM models with dynamic WACC

fonrex_dcf_compare.name: Fonrex DCF Models Comparison
fonrex_dcf_compare.description: Side-by-side comparison of all 3 DCF models (FCF, EPS, DDM)

fonrex_dcf_sensitivity.name: Fonrex DCF Sensitivity Matrix
fonrex_dcf_sensitivity.description: WACC × terminal growth rate sensitivity matrix for intrinsic value analysis

fonrex_insider_transactions.name: Fonrex Insider Transactions
fonrex_insider_transactions.description: SEC Form 4 insider trading data — purchases, sales, and option exercises (US stocks)

params.label: Ticker
params.description: US stock ticker (e.g. AAPL, MSFT, TSLA)

fonrex_sec_check.name: Fonrex SEC Check
fonrex_sec_check.description: Annual statements stored from Yahoo checked against the statements the company filed with the SEC (XBRL), year by year: gaps beyond the tolerance first, with the XBRL concept and a link to the filing on EDGAR. US filers, and foreign companies with a US listing (20-F)

params.label: Ticker
params.description: Ticker of an instrument with a US listing in the catalogue (e.g. AAPL, MSFT, SAP)

params.label: Years
params.description: Most recent fiscal years checked (1 to 30)

fonrex_etf_details.name: Fonrex ETF Details
fonrex_etf_details.description: UCITS ETF details from JustETF: TER, AUM, replication, top holdings, performance

params.label: ISIN
params.description: ETF ISIN code (e.g. IE00B4L5Y983 for iShares Core MSCI World)

fonrex_index_constituents.name: Fonrex Index Constituents
fonrex_index_constituents.description: List of constituents for major indices (S&P 500, CAC 40, NASDAQ 100, DAX)

fonrex_macro_rates.name: Fonrex Macro Rates
fonrex_macro_rates.description: Current macro-economic rates: US 10Y Treasury (FRED); euro AAA 10Y spot rate, ECB deposit facility rate and euro area stress index CISS (ECB)

params.label: Currency
params.description: USD (FRED) or EUR (ECB); empty for both

fonrex_macro_indicators.name: Fonrex Macro Indicators
fonrex_macro_indicators.description: Latest Eurostat indicators of a country or of the euro area: inflation (HICP) and core inflation, unemployment rate, GDP growth, economic sentiment and consumer confidence, with the change on the previous period

fonrex_macro_indicator_chart.name: Fonrex Macro Indicator Chart
fonrex_macro_indicator_chart.description: One Eurostat indicator over time, one line per country (inflation, unemployment, GDP growth, sentiment), last 10 years by default

params.label: Countries
params.description: Up to 10 countries or areas separated by commas (EA for the euro area)

params.label: Start
params.description: First period (10 years ago when empty)

fonrex_factor_exposure.name: Fonrex Factor Exposure
fonrex_factor_exposure.description: Exposure of a listing to the Fama/French factors (Kenneth French Data Library): alpha, betas with t-stats, R², on returns in US dollars

params.label: Ticker
params.description: Ticker of a listing with stored daily prices (e.g. AAPL, AIR.PA)

params.label: Model
params.description: ff3 (market, size, value), ff5 (plus profitability, investment), carhart (ff3 plus momentum)

params.label: Frequency
params.description: Monthly (60 months) or daily (252 days) returns

fonrex_factor_returns.name: Fonrex Factor Returns
fonrex_factor_returns.description: Cumulative returns of the Fama/French factors of a region (US, Europe, developed markets), in US dollars (Kenneth French Data Library)

params.label: Start
params.description: First period (10 years ago when empty)
